jobs.prompt: Use-case: text-localization / exact footwear catalog image edit. Create one square English B2B footwear detail panel, clean white margins, restrained charcoal sans-serif type. This is a real sourced shoe: preserve the exact source shoe geometry, toe proportions, mesh holes, side black/white stripe pattern, toggle bungee cord and slider, collar, pull loop and outsole shape/color. Keep the photographed shoe(s) as a literal photo inset or precise cutout; no new viewpoint, no invented texture or parts, no macros or magnification beyond source evidence, no generated color variants. No Chinese, no price, no supplier code, no extra logos, no certifications, no waterproof/grip/medical/weight/composition or stock promises. Product photo dominates, complete source shoe boundaries. Use the attached OffWhite pair photo as the only footwear source, remove cabinet/floor background around exact complete pair onto white with subtle natural grounding. Header: 'WIDE TOE BOX MESH SHOES'. Small factual labels in a side column: 'Toggle bungee closure', 'Open mesh upper', 'EU 39–48'. Footer: 'Confirm color-size mix and order requirements'. Wide toe is confirmed by the owner for this exact category; do not redraw or exaggerate the toe. Preserve both exact source shoes and brown soles.
